payload.title: AGENTS.md requires reading AGENTS.local.md as cloud preflight, but that file does not exist
payload.description:
Papyrus AGENTS.md (Core Rules) states: 'Before running any AWS-, Amplify-, sandbox-, or deployment-related command, read AGENTS.local.md and follow its local account/profile/env guidance. Treat AGENTS.local.md as required preflight context for cloud operations on this machine.'

/Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md DOES NOT EXIST. Two agent sessions on 2026-10-03 burned time hunting for it before proceeding without it. Auritus and Chattic.us both have one; Papyrus does not.

Either create it or drop the requirement. The facts it should carry, discovered the hard way:

  AWS_PROFILE=legacy  -> SSO account 335163751677, AdministratorAccess, us-east-1.
                         This is the 'legacy' account in the multi-account org and holds
                         essentially every Amplify app (Anth.us d1ffh6ny5rvtl, anthus-site
                         d23d9f23lg9obr, pilobol-us d1od6t7lzbwanr, auritus-site, Papyrus
                         dbsyytcm9drqa, Kanbus, Apricity, Biased-Decisions, ...).
  [profile anthus]    -> same account via the OLD non-SSO 'login_session = arn:aws:iam::335163751677:root'.
                         Session is expired and 'aws login' needs an interactive step only
                         Ryan can complete. Testing this profile - or a bare
                         'aws sts get-caller-identity' - reports 'session has expired' and
                         makes the account look unreachable when it is not. This cost real time.
  [profile Endymion]  -> DIFFERENT account 830955873957, has no Amplify apps. Do not create
                         resources there.

Also worth recording: repo skills reference paths like /Users/ryan/Projects/Papyrus/... which are stale on this machine (/Users/home/Projects/Papyrus). See skills/publication-bootstrap/SKILL.md.
